kpis.name: Gross Merchandise Value (GMV)
kpis.formula_description: Sum of item selling price plus customer freight charged across itemized orders.

kpis.name: Net Contribution Margin %
kpis.provenance: Hybrid (Olist Revenue + Synthetic COGS, Commission, Tax, Carrier Cost, Returns & Cancellations)
kpis.formula_description: (Gross Revenue - ICMS Tax - Marketplace Commission - Unit COGS - Packaging - Carrier Cost - Return Refunds - Cancellation Refunds - Reverse/Intercept Costs) / Gross Revenue.

alert_rule.message: Net contribution margin fell below 15.0% floor

kpis.name: Customer Repeat Purchase Rate %
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of unique customers (customer_unique_id) placing 2 or more orders.
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN total_orders >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)

kpis.name: Session-to-Order Placement Conversion %
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of tracked digital sessions resulting in Order_Placed (distinct from physical delivery).
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_placed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)

alert_rule.message: Tracked session order-placement rate dropped below 45.0%

kpis.name: Paid Marketing ROAS
kpis.provenance: Hybrid (Olist LTV GMV + Synthetic Campaign Spend)
kpis.formula_description: Total attributed customer GMV divided by actual paid media spend across non-organic campaigns.

alert_rule.message: Paid marketing ROAS dropped below 3.5x target

kpis.name: Late Delivery Rate % (Delivered Orders Only)
kpis.provenance: Original Olist Timestamps + Synthetic Carrier Tracking
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of delivered orders (fulfillment_state = 'Delivered') arriving after order_estimated_delivery_date.
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_late_delivery = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)

alert_rule.message: Late delivery rate exceeded 8.5% SLA threshold

kpis.name: Post-Delivery Item Return Rate %
kpis.provenance: Synthetic CommerceIQ v2 (returns_refunds on Delivered Olist Items)
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of delivered order line items with a post-delivery RMA record (excludes pre-delivery cancellations).
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_return = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 2)

kpis.name: Order Cancellation Rate %
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of total Olist orders with order_status = 'canceled'.
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN order_status = 'canceled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)

kpis.name: Monthly SKU-Seller Stockout Rate %
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of active (seller_id, product_id) snapshots experiencing stockout_occurred = True.
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN stockout_occurred = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)

kpis.name: Support Ticket 48h SLA Breach Rate %
kpis.formula_description: Percentage of support tickets exceeding the 48-hour resolution SLA.
kpis.sql_expression: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN sla_breached = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)
